feature.primordial.desc.guard: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Damage divided by (1 + 0.15 x M); 16 x active level EMC per hit. Armor pieces add their own powers and costs.
feature.primordial.desc.swift: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Adds 20% x M movement speed; 4 x active level EMC per second.
feature.primordial.desc.flight: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Full set grants flight at 1.5 x M vanilla speed; 1 x active level EMC per tick.
feature.primordial.desc.reach: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Adds 2 x M reach; 5 x active level EMC per second, within engine attribute ranges.
feature.primordial.desc.fireward: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Fire resistance for 12 x M seconds; 6 x active level EMC per renewal. Renews at 11 seconds remaining; removed when disabled or unequipped.
feature.primordial.desc.assault: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Adds 6 x M melee or arrow base damage; 12 x active level EMC per hit/shot.
feature.primordial.desc.night_vision: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Night vision for 12 x M seconds; 2 x active level EMC per renewal. Renews at 11 seconds remaining; removed when disabled or unequipped.
feature.primordial.desc.breath: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Water breathing for 12 x M seconds; 2 x active level EMC per renewal. Renews at 11 seconds remaining; removed when disabled or unequipped.
feature.primordial.desc.heal: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Heals up to M health per second; costs 16 x active level EMC per activation. No charge at full health.
feature.primordial.desc.feed: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Restores up to M food per second; costs 8 x active level EMC per activation. No charge when full.
feature.primordial.desc.knockback: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Adds 0.1 x M knockback resistance; 4 x active level EMC per second. Vanilla maximum is 1.
feature.primordial.desc.fall: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Fall damage divided by (1 + M); 8 x active level EMC per fall over 3 blocks.
feature.primordial.desc.area: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Mining radius M: view plane for pick, horizontal plane for shovel, cube for hammers. 8 x active level EMC per extra block; batched with protection checks.
feature.primordial.desc.vein: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Chains up to 64 x M matching ores; axes/katars also chain logs. 8 x active level EMC per extra block; takes priority over area mining.
feature.primordial.desc.smelt: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Smelts harvest drops using furnace recipes; 8 x active level EMC per block. A toggle effect: higher levels do not duplicate outputs.
feature.primordial.desc.silk: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Silk Touch; 8 x active level EMC per block. Takes priority over Fortune without its fee. Higher levels remain Silk Touch.
feature.primordial.desc.fortune: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Skill levels 1/2/3/4 produce Fortune 1/2/4/8. Costs 16 x active level EMC per block. Large ore yields use BigInteger and persistent batched delivery.
feature.primordial.desc.magnet: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Attracts eligible loaded drops within 4 x M blocks; 4 x active level EMC per second.
feature.primordial.desc.sweep: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Spreads melee damage to non-allied targets within 2 x M blocks, in batches; 12 x active level EMC per activation.
feature.primordial.desc.vampirism: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Heals 5% x M of actual melee damage, limited by missing health; 16 x active level EMC per activation. No charge at full health.
feature.primordial.desc.infinity: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Free normal arrows even without ammo; 8 x active level EMC per shot. Special arrows are consumed; free arrows cannot be collected. Higher levels do not add projectiles.
feature.primordial.desc.arrow_speed: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Arrow flight speed is 1.25 x M vanilla speed; 8 x active level EMC per arrow. Does not speed up drawing.
feature.primordial.desc.pierce: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Arrows hit up to 2 x M entities and stop at blocks; 12 x active level EMC per arrow.
screen.primordial.equipment.unlimited: Uncapped levels; effect power grows exponentially; upgrade and usage costs grow linearly
screen.primordial.equipment.zero_off: Active level: 0 disables; cannot exceed total level
screen.primordial.equipment.result.above: Active level cannot exceed total level.
feature.primordial.desc.singularity: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... First arrow impact creates a 3D black hole: radius 8 x M blocks, fixed 30-second lifetime, with pull and core damage still scaling with M. Costs 1024 x active level EMC. Protects containers/claims and does not load distant chunks.
feature.primordial.desc.insight: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Highlights loaded hostile mobs within 16 x M blocks; 8 x active level EMC per second only when targets exist.
feature.primordial.desc.undying: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Restores full health on fatal damage and rescues void falls; 4096 x active level EMC per activation, then 2 x M seconds of protection. Does not block forced kills.
feature.primordial.desc.stasis: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Locks the attacker for 2 x M seconds after taking damage; 16 x active level EMC per activation.
feature.primordial.desc.dash: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... B dashes 8 x M blocks along your view, stopping at obstacles; 256 x active level EMC per activation. Configurable key.
feature.primordial.desc.execute: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Hits on targets at 25% health or less add 25% x M of maximum health as damage; 64 x active level EMC per activation.
feature.primordial.desc.reap: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Aim at crops with the hoe and press B: radius 2 x M; grow immature crops or harvest/replant mature crops using one seed. Costs 16 x active level EMC per crop; batched inventory delivery.
feature.primordial.desc.dispel: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Removes up to M beneficial effects on melee hit; costs 32 x active level EMC only when effects exist.
feature.primordial.desc.rend: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Melee hits apply a wound for 5 x M seconds, dealing 2 x M damage per second. Repeated hits refresh it; 24 x active level EMC per application.
tooltip.primordial.equipment.innate: Signature abilities include level 1; configurable and upgradeable, with EMC usage costs
tooltip.primordial.equipment.signature_k: Active ability: B (configurable); holding the hoe prioritizes crop renewal
feature.primordial.desc.rapid_draw: M = 2^(active level - 1): 1, 2, 4, 8... Draw speed is 2 x M vanilla: level 1 fully charges in 10 ticks, level 2 in 5. Costs 8 x active level EMC per shot; insufficient EMC uses vanilla draw time. No shot, no charge.
